console_errors: Applying inline style violates the following Content Security Policy directive 'style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com'. Either the 'unsafe-inline' keyword, a hash ('sha256-9BchftstJR9ZPXUm7g+xVmzGWBLskGWn+vLhL5AID8c='), or a nonce ('nonce-...') is required to enable inline execution. Note that hashes do not apply to event handlers, style attributes and javascript: navigations unless the 'unsafe-hashes' keyword is present. The action has been blocked.
